name: Editorial Tri-Tone
description: A strict three-color editorial system: blush pink, golden butter, and deep burgundy wine. Despite eleven CSS variable names, only three hex values exist — every alias is a semantic rename of one of those three. Bricolage Grotesque (variable grotesk with optical-size axis) carries extreme-weight display at negative tracking. Instrument Serif italic is the expressive accent face for chapter numerals, pull-quotes, years, and signatures. JetBrains Mono handles all metadata and labels at tight uppercase tracking. Section-markers use the § convention.
descriptionZh: 严格三色编辑系统：粉红、金色黄油、深酒红。仅三个十六进制值，所有变量名均为语义别名。Bricolage Grotesque 可变字形用于极端重量展示文字。Instrument Serif 斜体用于章节数字、引文、年份和签名。JetBrains Mono 处理所有元数据和标签。
avoidFor: 需要柔和、舒适感的演示
